exposure: Continuous glucose monitoring metrics during pregnancy
poorly controlled glucose profile with peak hyperglycemia overnight
suboptimally controlled glucose profile with high variability, fasting hypoglycemia, and daytime hyperglycemia
suboptimally controlled glucose profile with minimal circadian variation
weekly glycemic measures related to centrality, spread, excursions, and circadian cycle patterns
continuous glucose monitoring use before pregnancy
cohort: 177 pregnant patients with type 1 or 2 diabetes mellitus who used Dexcom G6 continuous glucose monitoring and delivered a nonanomalous, singleton pregnancy at a tertiary center between 2019 and 2023
finding: Machine learning techniques identified four distinct glucose profiles in pregnant individuals with pregestational diabetes, with each profile associated with different risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
